_recipients_note: Addresses are NOT in this file -- the repo is public. They come from the RELEASE_PLANNING_RECIPIENTS secret: a JSON map, key 'CXCO' for the project report and 'CXCO:<team name>' for a team report; values are semicolon-separated addresses.
_pod_note: Pod = a label containing 'pod' OR named CXCO-<Team>-<number> (e.g. CXCO-Thunderbirds-2), the naming CXCO teams use without the word POD.
